### e/m Ratio
The **e/m ratio** is the specific charge of an electron, representing the ratio of its electric charge ($e$) to its mass ($m$). Its standard value is approximately $1.758 \times 10^{11}\text{ C/kg}$.

### Curved Path in Magnetic Field
Electrons follow a curved (circular) path because a moving charge in a magnetic field experiences a magnetic Lorentz force ($\vec{F} = q(\vec{v} \times \vec{B})$) that always acts perpendicular to both the velocity vector and the magnetic field vector, providing the necessary centripetal force without changing the particle's speed.
